title: The Electroweak Chiral Lagrangian for the Standard Model with a heavy Higgs
note: PDF library/arxiv-hep-ph-9308276v1/ — arXiv:hep-ph/9308276v1, stamped 14 Aug 1993. ELECTROWEAK, not QCD: the chiral Lagrangian here is the SU(2)_L x U(1)_Y one, and the 'chiral parameters' are non-decoupling effects of a heavy Higgs, not quark-mass expansions. It shares only the effective-Lagrangian machinery with the rest of this tranche. Registered from library intake; metadata read off page 1.
